name: android_push_file
description: Uploads a local file from the computer to the Android device (e.g. to /sdcard/Download/). Overwrites an existing file at remotePath without asking.

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.

localPath.description: Absolute path of the file on the computer.

remotePath.description: Absolute destination path on the device, e.g. /sdcard/Download/photo.jpg.
